summary: Stantec Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the date for its Q2 2026 earnings release (August 12, 2026) and a conference call on August 13, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change is involved. The filing is a routine earnings calendar notice for a foreign private issuer. No deal terms or special-situation event are present.
